scope: Bounded C4 state-history reclamation workload; this is not full M9 capacity qualification

workload.payload_generation: Concatenated SHA-256 hex digests of key, revision and block index

environment.keeper: Embedded single-node Keeper using the repository fixture
environment.storage_settings: Production ClickHouseState table definitions and normal MergeTree retention defaults

report: Read, commit and compact latency distributions
Per-pass active and inactive physical bytes, row counts and logical payload bytes
Elapsed time, source hashes, image identity and container memory samples
limits: Fixed keys establish a bound on retained current history, not on an increasing number of unique keys
Inactive MergeTree parts may await the default retention period and are reported separately
This workload does not establish production sizing, ingestion throughput, HTTP latency, derived-index capacity, concurrent writer capacity or a paired baseline regression result
